Name: Bed Tweaks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a simple mod that lets you resize the bed and make the bed's blankets transparent.

This mod was designed for use with (but doesn't require) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10021]Free Love[/url], which recognizes the increased bed size for multiple bed partners.

A config file is created when you run the game with this mod. Here are the config entries:

{
  "EnableMod": true,
  "BedWidth": 5, - how many tiles wide the bed should be
  "SheetTransparency": 1.0 - how transparent the blankets should be (1.0 means opaque, 0.0 means completely transparent blankets)
}



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
